answer: Because the anchor weight is recomputed from the comet history each close, the sonnet audit exposes the reduced figure and the promotion is earned rather than bought. Running a farm thus buys partial influence at full price for every alias, and the discount only arrives after the operator has already paid the bond. A new identity spends its first 2 epochs on probation, during which its attestations count for 31% of full weight. That is 4 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
